What You Can Expect

Zoom’s Enterprise Sales team is at the forefront of how the world’s largest organizations connect and collaborate. As Manager of Enterprise Sales in Tokyo, you will lead a team of account executives focused on enterprise clients across industry verticals, helping them unlock the full value of Zoom Workplace. You will own team performance and a portfolio of complex, high-value accounts, working alongside C-suite stakeholders to shape strategic deals that matter. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Tokyo, Japan office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

Our Enterprise Sales team in Japan partners with some of the region’s most influential organizations, guiding them through the full Zoom ecosystem. The team is structured by industry vertical, creating deep domain expertise and long-term client relationships built on trust. We work closely with technical resources, marketing, and global leadership to deliver outcomes that genuinely move the business forward.

Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue growth by meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual sales and product objectives across your team’s portfolio.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of account executives through strategic hiring, coaching, and performance management, partnering cross-functionally with recruitment to build team capability.
  • Manage account executive teams across Japan and additional markets as required.
  • Develop and deliver compelling client presentations, proposals, and Quarterly Business Reviews that clearly articulate Zoom’s value.
  • Engage C-level and VP-level executives in strategic conversations that address enterprise business needs and unlock new opportunities.
  • Apply solution-selling methodologies to guide complex sales cycles to close, growing revenue within existing accounts and new enterprise relationships.
  • Own pipeline management and accurate forecasting in Salesforce CRM, delivering timely insights and strategic recommendations to leadership.
  • Resolve client escalations thoroughly and efficiently, maintaining high satisfaction across the enterprise portfolio.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape, product developments, and industry trends to keep the team informed and positioned to win.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience managing large enterprise accounts, and at least 5 years managing a team.
  • Direct SaaS or cloud solutions selling experience; video or web conferencing background strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, with strong pipeline management and business forecasting skills.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and consultative communication skills, with executive-level business acumen and a high standard of professional integrity.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities and multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a fast-growing organization where processes and organizational maturity are still evolving, with a proven ability to proactively build, implement, and improve new processes and ways of working.
  • Salesforce CRM proficiency preferred.
  • Native Japanese fluency and business-level English proficiency required.

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.


Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.


If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.


Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

What You Can Expect

As our Marketing Data Operations Analyst, you will serve as both a technical expert and an advisory partner to EMEA marketing stakeholders, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter campaign and strategic decisions. You will own the segmentation, database management, and data quality frameworks that power Zoom's marketing database, working closely with the wider Marketing Operations team, IT, and Data teams. This role sits within the Digital Transformation Office, giving you visibility across how data strategy connects to enterprise marketing outcomes at scale. This role requires working hours aligned to EMEA markets, with a shift of 12:30 PM to 8:30 PM IST.


About the Team

The Marketing Data Operations team is part of the wider Marketing Operations team within Zoom's Digital Transformation Office and is responsible for the infrastructure, processes, and operational frameworks that power our marketing database. We enable data accessibility, quality, and operational execution for Enterprise Marketing, ensuring that marketing teams have reliable, actionable data to inform campaigns and strategic decisions. We are a collaborative team working across Marketing Operations, IT, and Data functions to keep Zoom's marketing database accurate, current, and strategically aligned.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze audience and database performance metrics, surfacing key trends, patterns, and actionable insights that inform EMEA marketing strategy and decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver recurring insight outputs including audience health readouts, engagement trend analyses, and segmentation performance summaries for marketing stakeholders.
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and systemic issues in current processes, segmentation logic, and data quality, leading continuous improvement initiatives without waiting for escalation.
  • Create, manage, and evolve audience segments and segmentation models aligned to EMEA regional objectives, translating marketing requirements into effective audience builds grounded in business context.
  • Own compliance with privacy regulations including GDPR and internal opt-in requirements for new and existing data within the marketing database.
  • Collaborate with Data Operations, Marketing Operations, and cross-functional IT and Data teams to ensure the marketing database remains accurate, current, and aligned with organizational needs.
  • Build and maintain proactive relationships with EMEA marketing stakeholders, delivering enablement sessions that improve their understanding and utilization of Zoom's marketing database.
  • Communicate complex data concepts clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders, providing data-driven context that explains what the data means and what actions it suggests.


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in a technology, data, or business-related field, or equivalent experience, with 8 or more years of experience working with large-scale B2B or B2C marketing databases.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing data ecosystems including CRM systems (Salesforce), marketing automation platforms (Pardot/Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), CDP platforms (Data Cloud), data warehouses (Snowflake), and BI tools (Tableau).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries for segmentation, analysis, and performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data into business-facing insights, articulating not just what the data shows but what it means for marketing stakeholders and what actions it might inform.
  • Proven ability to own and deliver projects independently from scoping to completion, managing timelines and stakeholder expectations without constant oversight.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset that identifies issues before they are reported, brings solutions alongside diagnosis, and drives improvement without waiting for direction.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non-technical audiences clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, combined with strong attention to detail and a quality-first approach.
